spec.description:
Bradford Fire Protection - Wall Batt (Bradford Rockwool Fireseal
Curtain Wall Batts) is a semi-rigid, non-combustible stone wool insulation batt
formulated for fire-safing, spandrel insulation, and perimeter fire containment
in external wall and curtain wall systems. Manufactured from bio-soluble
rockwool fibres, it provides remarkable resistance to shrinkage at extreme
temperatures up to 1000°C, maintaining compartmentation between floor slabs and
external facade panels. Available in 50mm and 100mm thicknesses, it achieves
high thermal and acoustic performance while satisfying NCC fire resistance
requirements.
features:
Non-combustible stone wool material complying
with AS 1530.1

High resistance to shrinkage at temperatures
exceeding 1000°C

Formulated specifically for curtain wall spandrel and
perimeter fire safing

Provides thermal insulation and acoustic sound
dampening in commercial walls
Performance unaffected by contact with water

Easy to cut and friction-fit
into tight structural frames or pin behind spandrel panels

Meets stringent
NCC fire barrier and fire stopping requirements

technical.value:

or 168 mm width (or 1200 x 600 mm slab)

spec.fire:
Non-combustible to AS 1530.1; AS/NZS 1530.3:
Ignitability 0, Spread of Flame 0, Heat Evolved 0, Smoke Developed 0-1; Achieves
fire resistance levels (FRL) up to -/120/120 or -/240/240 in tested
wall/edge-of-slab assemblies to AS 1530.4
spec.compliance:
AS 1530.1, AS 1530.4,
NCC Volume One fire-rated facade and non-combustible external wall provisions
spec.sustainability:
Manufactured from up to 40% recycled materials; FBS-1
bio-soluble formulation; zero ODP
install:
Cut Fireseal Curtain Wall
Batts to required spandrel cavity or slab edge width

Install with mechanical
impaling pins and speed clips, or support brackets at recommended centres

Ensure batts are fitted under 10-15% compression between floor slab edge and
facade transom/spandrel

Butt adjacent batts tightly together ensuring
continuous fire-stopping with no gaps

Cover with galvanized steel smoke
barrier backing sheet or approved fire-rated sealant as per system
specification
selection_checklist:
Verify required FRL
(e.g. 60, 90, 120, or 240 minutes) for facade perimeter fire stop

Measure
slab-to-transom void width to determine correct batt thickness and width
Confirm fixing method (impaling pins, friction fit, or steel brackets)
Verify non-combustible compliance under NCC Section C for commercial facades
limitations:
Must be
mechanically secured to prevent dislodgement during thermal movement

Not an
external weather-facing finish; must be enclosed within facade cladding

Must
be protected from continuous water soaking during construction
spec.warranty: Backed by CSR Bradford product warranty

retrieval.rag_summary:
Bradford Fire
Protection - Wall Batt (Rockwool Fireseal Curtain Wall Batts) is a high-density,
non-combustible stone wool batt engineered for perimeter fire containment and
spandrel insulation in commercial curtain walls and external wall assemblies. It
maintains structural integrity and resists shrinkage at temperatures up
to 1000°C, stopping vertical fire spread between building storeys at the slab
edge. Certified non-combustible to AS 1530.1 and tested to AS 1530.4 for FRLs up
to -/240/240, it satisfies NCC non-combustibility mandates for commercial
high-rise envelopes.
